description: This file provides FastAPI dependencies related to authentication, including functions for retrieving an AuthService instance and extracting the current user ID from a Bearer token in the request headers.

methods.name: AuthService get_auth_service( user_repo: Annotated[UserRepository, Depends(lambda: UserRepository())] )
methods.description: Provides an AuthService instance via dependency injection, constructed with a UserRepository.

methods.name: int get_current_user_id( request: Request, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(get_auth_service)], )
methods.description: Extracts and validates a Bearer token from the request headers, returning the user ID if valid, or raising an HTTP 401 exception otherwise.

ctags.name: get_current_user_id
ctags.signature: ( request: Request, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(get_auth_service)], )
